tasks.title: Implement content hashing and file fingerprinting
tasks.description: Compute SHA-256 content hashes and stable file identities. Capture size and mtime as optimization hints, but use content hash as the authoritative change signal.

tasks.title: Implement SQLite connection and migration manager
tasks.description: Create database initialization, schema version tracking, transactional migrations, foreign-key enforcement, busy timeout and WAL configuration. Keep vector extension optional.

tasks.title: Create core relational schema
tasks.description: Implement repositories, scan_runs, source_files, code_bricks, brick_dependencies and external_packages tables with indexes, constraints and provenance fields. Use surrogate primary keys where SQLite requires them.

tasks.title: Implement incremental scan planner
tasks.description: Compare discovered files and fingerprints with stored state to classify added, changed, unchanged and deleted files. Persist scan-run counters and support dry-run planning.

tasks.title: Define language adapter interface and Python adapter
tasks.description: Create a language adapter contract for detection, parsing, symbol extraction and parser diagnostics. Implement Python as the first supported language.

tasks.title: Integrate Tree-sitter runtime and Python grammar
tasks.description: Add pinned Tree-sitter runtime and Python grammar dependencies. Build parser initialization with deterministic grammar loading and clear startup errors.

tasks.title: Extract Python function definitions
tasks.description: Extract top-level and nested functions with qualified names, signatures, decorators, docstrings, source spans and content hashes. Preserve exact source offsets.

tasks.title: Extract Python class and method definitions
tasks.description: Extract classes, bases, class docstrings, methods and qualified names. Represent methods as bricks linked to their containing class where appropriate.

tasks.title: Extract imports and external package references
tasks.description: Parse import and from-import statements, normalize module names and distinguish standard library, local modules and third-party dependencies where resolvable.

tasks.title: Build local symbol index for a repository
tasks.description: Resolve module paths and qualified symbols across indexed Python files. Support absolute and relative imports without executing source code.

tasks.title: Extract function-call and inheritance relationships
tasks.description: Use AST nodes to identify statically visible calls, class bases and method references. Record confidence and resolution status rather than guessing dynamic dispatch.

tasks.title: Persist brick and dependency provenance
tasks.description: Persist extracted symbols with repository, file, qualified name, source span, parser version and content hash. Persist dependency edges with edge type and resolution confidence.

tasks.title: Implement parser error and partial-file handling
tasks.description: Store parser diagnostics and allow valid symbols from partially malformed files to be indexed when the parser provides recoverable nodes. Never execute scanned code.

tasks.title: Implement symbol identity and deduplication rules
tasks.description: Define stable brick identity using repository/file identity, qualified symbol name and content version. Handle renames and duplicate code across repositories without conflating provenance.

tasks.title: Implement brick contract representation
tasks.description: Expose a contract containing symbol kind, signature, docstring, decorators, source location, language, imports, package requirements and dependency summary without requiring full source body.

tasks.title: Implement exact and lexical brick search
tasks.description: Implement SQLite FTS5 indexing for symbol names, signatures, docstrings, tags and summaries. Add insert/update/delete synchronization and safe query handling.

tasks.title: Implement filtered catalog search API
tasks.description: Add search filters for repository, language, symbol kind, path, package dependency and minimum portability. Return stable IDs and concise result metadata.

tasks.title: Implement dependency graph traversal
tasks.description: Retrieve incoming/outgoing dependencies to a configurable depth, detect cycles and mark unresolved edges. Apply a maximum node/edge budget.

tasks.title: Implement dependency-aware source extraction
tasks.description: Extract a selected brick with required internal helpers and import headers. Preserve source order where possible and report omitted/unresolved dependencies.

tasks.title: Implement repository-specific import normalization
tasks.description: Offer optional normalization of internal imports for extracted bundles. Keep original source unchanged and record every rewrite in the extraction manifest.

tasks.title: Generate extraction manifest and provenance report
tasks.description: Emit a manifest listing selected bricks, included dependencies, source files, source hashes, imports, transformations and unresolved dependencies.

tasks.title: Add extraction output modes
tasks.description: Support source bundle, contract-only and JSON metadata outputs. Make source inclusion explicit and default contract responses to body-free.

tasks.title: Define composition request and proposal models
tasks.description: Define target language/version, interface contract, selected brick IDs, adaptation instructions, constraints and output artifact metadata. Treat generated code as a proposal.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic composition context builder
tasks.description: Assemble contracts, source bundles, dependency manifests and target constraints into bounded context for an external model or agent. Do not call an LLM from Core.

tasks.title: Implement composition provider interface
tasks.description: Define a provider protocol for proposing code changes, with a mock provider for tests. Keep model/vendor configuration outside core indexing and storage.

tasks.title: Implement adaptation proposal workflow
tasks.description: Create a workflow that takes selected bricks and an integration spec, returns proposed files/diffs and a rationale, and records model/provider metadata when used.

tasks.title: Implement composition dependency and license report
tasks.description: Aggregate external packages, detected license metadata where available, source origins and unresolved dependency warnings for selected bricks.

tasks.title: Implement optional language adaptation boundary
tasks.description: Define an explicit extension point for cross-language adaptation. Mark transpilation as experimental and require human review and validation.

tasks.title: Add proposal approval and export workflow
tasks.description: Allow a proposal to be accepted, rejected or exported to a separate destination. Require explicit destination allowlisting and preserve the original source catalog.

tasks.title: Implement isolated validation runner interface
tasks.description: Define a runner that executes configured checks in a temporary workspace with timeouts, resource limits and no implicit network access. Start with Python compile checks.

tasks.title: Implement syntax and compile validation for extracted Python
tasks.description: Run compileall or py_compile against generated bundles in an isolated temporary workspace and capture diagnostics.

tasks.title: Implement dependency availability checks
tasks.description: Check declared Python packages against a supplied environment or lockfile without installing packages automatically. Distinguish missing, unknown and incompatible requirements.

tasks.title: Implement unit-test harness for extracted bundles
tasks.description: Allow a caller-supplied test command or test package to run in the isolated workspace. Require explicit opt-in for execution.

tasks.title: Implement validation report model
tasks.description: Create structured validation reports with checks, statuses, diagnostics, timestamps, bundle hash and environment metadata.

tasks.title: Add end-to-end Python vertical-slice test
tasks.description: Create a fixture repository containing functions, classes, imports and dependencies. Test registration, scan, AST extraction, persistence, search, contract inspection, bundling and validation.

tasks.title: Add incremental re-indexing and deletion regression tests
tasks.description: Verify unchanged files are skipped, changed files update their bricks and dependencies, deleted files are marked removed, and repeated scans remain idempotent.

tasks.title: Add security and filesystem boundary tests
tasks.description: Test path traversal, symlink escape, oversized files, ignored directories, malformed source, unsafe export paths and attempts to execute source during indexing.

tasks.title: Add performance baseline and scan metrics
tasks.description: Measure files per second, parse time, database write time, search latency and memory use on a documented fixture corpus. Record baseline without premature optimization.

tasks.title: Document MVP setup, operations and limitations
tasks.description: Document installation, repository registration, scanning, search, contract inspection, extraction, validation, database backup and known limitations.
